scope: Proposition 9.7 (Relative continuation) of the manuscript “Finite ordinary minimal model programs on compact Kähler fourfolds” (preprints/Finite-ordinary-minimal-model-programs-on-compact-Kahler-fourfolds-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 056 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1b9511572d6c717), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 61. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let π: T → V be a projective bimeromorphic morphism of normal compact Kähler spaces. Assume T is globally strongly Q-factorial and (T, B + M) is rational gdlt, with projective carrier and nef data over V . If its adjoint is not curve-nef over V , there is an elementary negative step over V . Its target is projective over V , compact Kähler, globally strongly Q-factorial, and gdlt with the transformed data. The construction is available after every finite prefix whose final adjoint is not curve-nef over V . For gklt data one may choose any negative extremal ray in the global degree cone.
